user.title: Cloud Quota Guard
user.description: Monitor verified cloud quota sources. Configure warning and cutoff percentages per source. Automatic actions require explicit targets and consent.

abort.already_configured: Cloud Quota Guard is already configured.

configure.name: Configure quota
configure.description: Register a verified measurement source and target integrations.

id.name: Metric ID
id.description: Stable lowercase identifier (letters, digits and underscores).

entry_ids.name: Target integration IDs
entry_ids.description: Home Assistant config entry IDs to disable at this source's cutoff percentage. Oracle sources use compute instance OCIDs instead.

kind.name: Quota type
kind.description: Distinguish a rate limit, free allowance, or monetary budget.

source.name: Verified source
source.description: Provider documentation URL or a clear description of the usage source.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: For example requests, characters, or USD.

usage_entity.name: Usage sensor
usage_entity.description: Current-period usage sensor with period and source timestamp attributes.

limit_entity.name: Limit sensor
limit_entity.description: Optional sensor exposing the effective allowance.

limit.name: Fixed allowance
limit.description: A verified allowance if no limit sensor is available.

period_attribute.name: Period attribute
period_attribute.description: Usage sensor attribute containing the provider period ID.

timestamp_attribute.name: Timestamp attribute
timestamp_attribute.description: Usage sensor attribute with the timezone-aware source timestamp.

max_age.name: Maximum age
max_age.description: Seconds until a measurement is considered stale (30–86400).

enforce.name: Enable automatic cutoff
enforce.description: Use this source's selected cutoff percentage. Oracle sources power off selected compute instances; other sources disable mapped Home Assistant integrations. Never automatically restart.

usage_url.name: Usage page URL
usage_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL or local dashboard path. This is a reference link, not an automatically scraped data source.

usage_attribute.name: Usage attribute
usage_attribute.description: Optional numeric attribute on the usage sensor; leave blank to read its state.

period_entity.name: Period sensor
period_entity.description: Optional sensor whose state contains the provider period ID. Overrides the period attribute.

timestamp_entity.name: Timestamp sensor
timestamp_entity.description: Optional sensor whose state contains the timezone-aware provider timestamp. Overrides the timestamp attribute.

period_mode.name: Reporting period
period_mode.description: Read a provider period from a sensor, or explicitly select a calendar month derived from the source timestamp.

period_timezone.name: Month reset timezone
period_timezone.description: Provider timezone for calendar-month periods, for example UTC or Asia/Jerusalem. Samples from an earlier month are not reused.

warning_percent.name: Warning percentage
warning_percent.description: Percentage at which to alert; must be lower than cutoff.

cutoff_percent.name: Cutoff percentage
cutoff_percent.description: User-selected automatic-action threshold, above warning and no higher than 100.

oracle_instance_ids.name: Oracle compute instance OCIDs
oracle_instance_ids.description: Only for an Oracle API source. Explicit instance targets checked against the connection's region; never inferred from a sensor or HA integration.

timestamp_mode.name: Measurement timestamp
timestamp_mode.description: Use the source attribute or explicitly opt in to the last Home Assistant state report.

threshold_mode.name: Alert comparison
threshold_mode.description: Percentage of allowance, usage reaches an amount, or remaining balance falls to an amount.

warning_value.name: Warning amount
warning_value.description: In the source unit; no allowance is required.

critical_value.name: Critical amount
critical_value.description: Higher than warning for usage, lower for remaining balance.

report.name: Report measurement
report.description: Submit a verified quota measurement. Administrator access is required.

id.name: Metric ID
id.description: ID of a metric previously registered with configure.

used.name: Used
used.description: Verified consumption in the current provider period.

limit.name: Allowance
limit.description: Optional verified limit. Omit to record usage without percentages or cutoff; a configured fixed limit is used if available.

period.name: Period
period.description: Provider period identifier; changes reset threshold notification latches.

timestamp.name: Source timestamp
timestamp.description: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp of the provider measurement.

expires_at.name: Quota reset time
expires_at.description: Optional timezone-aware ISO timestamp after which this reading must not be evaluated.

acknowledge_retired.name: Acknowledge retired source
acknowledge_retired.description: Remove a stopped source from Action required without deleting its history or changing active monitoring.

id.name: Retired metric ID
id.description: Only a retired source can be acknowledged.

add_dashboard_view.name: Add English dashboard view
add_dashboard_view.description: Append a Cloud Quotas view to an existing editable dashboard. Preserve all existing views; repeated calls do not add duplicates.

dashboard_path.name: Dashboard URL path
dashboard_path.description: Path without hostname or slashes, for example dashboard-cloud-quotas or lovelace.

source.title: Sensor quota source
source.description:
Choose a usage sensor, optional allowance and measurement timestamp. A usage-page URL is a reference link. Automatic cutoff is off by default.

[Setup guide: what to enter and how to get credentials]({setup_help_url}).

data_description.id: Stable lowercase identifier (letters, digits and underscores).
data_description.name: Human-readable quota name.
data_description.entry_ids: Config entry IDs to disable at the cutoff; cannot target Quota Guard itself.
data_description.kind: Distinguish a rate limit, free allowance, or monetary budget.
data_description.unit: For example requests, characters, or USD.
data_description.usage_entity: Current-period usage sensor with period and source timestamp attributes.
data_description.limit_entity: Optional sensor exposing the effective allowance.
data_description.limit: A verified allowance if no limit sensor is available.
data_description.period_attribute: Usage sensor attribute containing the provider period ID.
data_description.timestamp_attribute: Usage sensor attribute with the timezone-aware source timestamp.
data_description.max_age: Seconds until a measurement is considered stale (30–86400).
data_description.enforce: Disable explicitly mapped integrations at your configured cutoff percentage; never automatically re-enable them.
data_description.usage_url: Optional HTTP(S) URL or local dashboard path. This is a reference link, not an automatically scraped data source.
data_description.usage_attribute: Optional numeric attribute on the usage sensor; leave blank to read its state.
data_description.period_entity: Optional sensor whose state contains the provider period ID. Overrides the period attribute.
data_description.timestamp_entity: Optional sensor whose state contains the timezone-aware provider timestamp. Overrides the timestamp attribute.
data_description.period_mode: Read a provider period from a sensor, or explicitly select a calendar month derived from the source timestamp.
data_description.period_timezone: Provider timezone for calendar-month periods, for example UTC or Asia/Jerusalem. Samples from an earlier month are not reused.

github.title: Connect GitHub to Quota Guard
github.description:
Enter a token explicitly for Quota Guard. We validate it with GitHub and monitor its REST core quota. No repository permissions are needed for the rate-limit endpoint. This does not read another integration’s token or enable cutoff.

[Setup guide: what to enter and how to get credentials]({setup_help_url}).

data_description.name: A display label you choose, for example Personal GitHub. This is not a login field.
data_description.access_token: The complete token for the GitHub account to monitor, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Do not enter your password.

google.title: Connect a Google project to Quota Guard
google.description:
Paste the service-account JSON key as one line and choose the project APIs to monitor. The key is checked locally; provider access is checked during polling. Enable Service Usage and Cloud Monitoring and grant their read permissions in Google Cloud. No other integration’s credentials are read. Cutoff stays off.

[Setup guide: what to enter and how to get credentials]({setup_help_url}).

data_description.name: A display label, for example Home Google project.
data_description.service_account_info: The complete service-account JSON file contents on one line. Not a file path, API key or OAuth client-secret file.
data_description.services: Select only APIs used in the project identified by project_id in the key.

remove_provider.title: Remove a provider connection
remove_provider.description: Remove its saved credentials and stop polling. Its measurement history is retained separately. No disabled integration is re-enabled.

cutoff.title: Configure thresholds and integration cutoff
cutoff.description: Choose warning and cutoff percentages. When enabled, only the explicitly selected Home Assistant integrations may be disabled at your cutoff percentage. This does not power off cloud resources. Disabled integrations are never re-enabled automatically. Leave cutoff off for monitoring only.

oracle.title: Connect Oracle Cloud API
oracle.description: Use an OCI API signing key supplied directly to Quota Guard. OCI auth tokens, SSH keys and API keys from other integrations are not used. This step only reads usage. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

data_description.region: For example il-jerusalem-1. Use the tenancy home region for usage reports and the region containing your cutoff instances.
data_description.private_key: Paste the complete PEM file, including BEGIN and END lines. Multiline and flattened pastes are accepted. This is not an OCI auth token or an instance SSH key.
data_description.fingerprint: Copy the fingerprint shown under your OCI user's API keys.

oracle_meters.title: Choose Oracle usage meters
oracle_meters.description: Select the service/product/unit combinations to monitor. These are reported usage meters, not automatically verified free allowances. After saving, use Configure thresholds and cutoff to enter your allowance and percentages for each meter. Unselected meters are archived with history retained. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

oracle_cutoff.title: Oracle allowance, thresholds and power-off
oracle_cutoff.description: {source_name}. Enter the verified monthly allowance in {unit}. Warning and cutoff percentages are your choice. When enabled, Quota Guard sends SOFTSTOP only to the instance OCIDs you enter, in this connection's region. Confirm that stopping them reduces this quota's usage. No instance is restarted automatically. Oracle reports are delayed, and stopping compute does not stop storage or other resource charges. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}). Saving an enabled rule may request power-off immediately if reported usage is already at or above your threshold.

data.confirm_targets: I confirm these instances consume this quota and may be powered off

data_description.limit: Use the allowance and exact unit applicable to your account. Leave blank for usage-only monitoring.
data_description.oracle_instance_ids: Paste each full instance OCID and press Enter. Every selected instance is checked against Oracle before saving.
data_description.cutoff_percent: Must be greater than the warning percentage and no higher than 100. You can choose a lower threshold to allow for delayed reports.

ai.title: AI services
ai.description: Choose a provider and account type. API/team connections use provider reporting APIs; personal subscriptions use a manual reading or an existing sensor. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

tuya.title: Tuya usage
tuya.description: Connect a usage sensor or enter a reading from Tuya Developer Console > Cloud > Data Statistics. Automatic Tuya quota polling is not supported here. Developer-project usage may differ from Home Assistant's Tuya Sharing integration. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

ai_unavailable.title: {provider} usage
ai_unavailable.description: Automatic quota retrieval is not supported for this provider. Continue to enter a manual reading, or close and choose an existing sensor. No credentials are needed. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

ai_connect.title: Connect {provider}
ai_connect.description:
{instructions}

This connection starts in monitoring-only mode. [Where to find credentials and what to enter]({setup_help_url}).

data_description.api_key: Paste the key itself, without a Bearer prefix. Never use a password or browser session cookie.
data_description.limit: Use the unit and reporting period described above. Leave blank to show the reported amount without a percentage. This does not change the provider's spending limit.

usage_manual.title: {provider} — manual usage
usage_manual.description: Create a manually updated source using your [provider usage page]({usage_url}). Enter only a reading actually shown for your account. Percent readings use an allowance of 100. Automatic cutoff starts off.

data_description.limit: Required to calculate a percentage from requests, tokens, messages, or USD. For % readings, 100 is used automatically.

usage_reading.title: Update {source_name}
usage_reading.description: Enter the value in {unit} from the [usage page]({usage_url}). This is a manual snapshot, not continuous monitoring. It expires after 24 hours or the supplied reset time, whichever comes first. Remaining values require an allowance. An existing enabled cutoff can act on a new reading.

data_description.period: Copy the provider's period or window, for example 2026-11 or a named weekly window.
data_description.timestamp: The source's timestamp with timezone, for example 2026-11-14T18:30:00+02:00. If the page shows a live value, use the time you read it; do not relabel a delayed report as current.
data_description.expires_at: If shown by the provider, enter the reset timestamp with timezone. The old reading will stop being evaluated at that time.

imou.title: Set up IMOU usage
imou.description: OP1013 means IMOU has rejected calls because its total call allowance is exhausted. Quota Guard detects that error automatically; it does not invent a usage count or reset time. Connect an existing quota sensor or enter the actual reading from IMOU My Resources. [Setup guide]({setup_help_url}).

dashboard.title: Add English dashboard view
dashboard.description: Choose an existing editable dashboard. A full-width Cloud Quotas view will be added once, preserving your other views. Automatically generated and YAML dashboards need a separate editable dashboard first.

request_counters.title: Automatic HTTP request counters

alerts.title: Warning and critical alerts
alerts.description: Choose a source. Alerts work without automatic cutoff and without a verified allowance.

alert_mode.title: How should {source_name} trigger alerts?
alert_mode.description: Choose the comparison in {unit}. A percentage requires a known allowance. Amount thresholds do not.

alert_values.title: Warning and critical values

notifications.title: Alert delivery
notifications.description: Home Assistant persistent notifications are always enabled. Add optional delivery through an existing email, Telegram, GreenAPI / WhatsApp or other notify service. External delivery is off by default.

notification_add.title: Notification destination
notification_add.description: Choose an existing Home Assistant notify service or notify entity. Configure email / SMTP, Telegram or GreenAPI in Home Assistant first if it is missing. Enter recipients only if your notify service requires them. Saving does not send a test message.

family.title: Family screen-time monitoring
family.description: Connect usage sensors from your existing family integrations. This measures screen time, not cloud API requests.

family_sensor.title: Connect {provider} screen time
family_sensor.description: Choose a daily screen-time sensor in minutes. Warning and critical values are your own rules. The optional allowance is a local daily target; it does not change the provider’s parental controls. Data expires at local midnight. When no provider poll timestamp exists, freshness means the last Home Assistant state report. This form does not disable or lock devices.

provider_cutoff.title: Provider-side automatic cutoff
provider_cutoff.description: Choose a measured source. These controls can affect applications outside Home Assistant. Local integration cutoff is configured separately. Everything is off by default.

provider_targets.title: {action}
provider_targets.description:
{instructions}

Configure warning and critical thresholds first. Enabling requires exact targets and explicit scope confirmation. Delayed reporting can overshoot a budget; prefer a native provider spending cap as the first safeguard. Saving this step only reads target metadata.

data.control_api_key: OpenRouter Management key (optional if already saved)
data.enabled: Enable provider cutoff at the critical threshold
data.confirm_scope: I confirm these targets consume this metric and understand the action affects their applications

provider_confirm.title: Review automatic provider cutoff

data.confirm: Enable this exact action for these targets

error.targets_required: Use warning below cutoff (0–100%) and select valid targets before enabling automatic cutoff.
error.invalid_source: Check the source ID, URL, timezone and measurement settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not validate the token with GitHub. Check the token and connection.
error.invalid_credentials: Enter a valid Google service-account JSON key and select APIs.
error.invalid_oracle_credentials: Check the tenancy/user OCIDs, region, API key fingerprint, complete PEM key and optional passphrase.
error.oracle_access_failed: Oracle usage could not be read. Check the home region, API signing credentials and read usage-report permission.
error.oracle_meters_required: Select at least one reported usage meter.
error.oracle_confirmation_required: Confirm that the selected compute instances consume this quota before enabling power-off.
error.oracle_cutoff_invalid: Use a positive allowance, warning below cutoff (0–100%), and valid instance OCIDs in this connection's region. Check read-instance access. Power-off also needs INSTANCE_POWER_ACTION permission.
error.ai_credentials_invalid: Check the key, connection fields, allowance and percentages. Warning must be below cutoff.
error.ai_access_failed: Could not read this account's report. Check the key type, read permissions, account plan and any required team ID or currency. No connection was saved.
error.invalid_reading: Check the value, reporting period and timezone-aware timestamps. Readings must be fresh, unexpired and no older than the previous reading. Remaining values require a valid allowance.
error.dashboard_failed: Could not add the view. Choose an editable storage dashboard with saved views and check that cloud-quotas is not used by a different view.
error.invalid_alert_values: Enter non-negative warning and critical values in the correct order.
error.notification_invalid: Check the destination, recipients and alert levels. Up to five destinations are supported.
error.provider_control_invalid: Check permissions, exact target IDs and scope confirmation. Configure amount thresholds or an allowance first. No provider action was taken.

abort.not_loaded: Load Cloud Quota Guard before configuring sources.
abort.no_sources: No sensor sources to edit. Add a source first.
abort.no_metrics: No active metrics. Add a source or wait for the next provider poll.
abort.oracle_no_usage: Oracle accepted the connection but returned no usage meters this month. Try again after OCI reports usage. No connection or power-off rule was saved.
abort.no_manual_readings: No manual source exists for this provider yet. Choose a manual reading first.
abort.balance_only: This connection reports available credits, not consumption. Percentages and automatic cutoff do not apply.
abort.no_notification_services: No notify services or entities are available. Set up a Home Assistant notification integration first.
abort.no_notification_channels: No external notification destinations are configured.
abort.no_family_sensors: No matching daily screen-time sensors with a date and minute units are available. Set up the selected family integration first.
abort.provider_control_unsupported: This source has no supported provider control API. Use local integration cutoff only for the workload you intend to stop. Oracle power-off has its own form. Family restrictions must be configured in the family app.
